what: The window eye: a 26x26 window at full resolution, 13 bins of 2 px, V1 4x5/2, raised on eight shapes (faces held out); the control for the foveated eye.
nudge: raised with the quadratic nudge on cadence-net 0.74.0; the checkpoint stores the cross-entropy nudge, the one a Brain loads, with every learned array unchanged, and was loaded and saved once by cadence-net 0.94.0 into the checkpoint format 0.95.2 reads. The control never learns in compare.py; frozen, the converted file answers the window dart test exactly as the original does (20 trials per jump, seed 3).
